lectures.title: Introduction to Software Engineering and Object-Oriented Fundamentals
lectures.summary: Introduction to modern software engineering principles, the role of object technology in building high-quality systems, and foundational concepts of object-oriented programming including classes, objects, and encapsulation.
topics: Overview of software engineering challenges and industrial software systems
Quality attributes: correctness, robustness, extendibility, reusability

lectures.title: Inheritance, Polymorphism and Dynamic Binding
lectures.summary: Deep dive into advanced object-oriented mechanisms including single and multiple inheritance, polymorphism, dynamic binding, and their role in creating flexible and reusable software architectures.

lectures.title: Genericity and Information Hiding
lectures.summary: Exploration of generic programming techniques for creating reusable components and information hiding principles for managing complexity and ensuring proper encapsulation in large systems.

lectures.title: Design by Contract: Assertions and Program Correctness
lectures.summary: Introduction to Design by Contract methodology using preconditions, postconditions, and class invariants to specify software behavior and guarantee program reliability through formal contracts.

lectures.title: Fundamental Design Patterns I: Creational and Structural Patterns
lectures.summary: Study of essential design patterns for object creation and structural composition, including Singleton, Factory, Adapter, and Composite patterns with practical applications.
topics: Creational patterns: Singleton, Factory Method, Abstract Factory

lectures.title: Fundamental Design Patterns II: Behavioral Patterns
lectures.summary: Examination of behavioral design patterns focusing on Observer, Visitor, Strategy, and Command patterns for managing object interactions and responsibilities in complex systems.
topics: Observer pattern: event handling and notifications
Visitor pattern: operations on object structures

lectures.title: Software Architecture: Structuring Large-Scale Programs
lectures.summary: Techniques for organizing and structuring large software systems, including architectural styles, component organization, module dependencies, and managing system complexity.

lectures.title: Requirements Engineering Fundamentals
lectures.summary: Introduction to requirements engineering processes, techniques for eliciting, analyzing, and documenting software requirements, including functional and non-functional requirements.

lectures.title: Agile Development Methods and Practices
lectures.summary: Overview of agile software development methodologies, including Scrum, XP practices, iterative development, and how agile techniques integrate with software engineering principles.

lectures.title: Software Engineering Process and Quality Assurance
lectures.summary: Comprehensive overview of software engineering processes, quality assurance practices, testing strategies, and integration of construction, architecture, and engineering principles in professional software development.
topics: Integration of OO principles, patterns, contracts, and agile methods
